title: Kojiro and Furrari
statementMd:
Motorist Kojiro spent $10$ years saving up for his favorite car brand, Furrari. Finally Kojiro's dream came true! Kojiro now wants to get to his girlfriend Johanna to show off his car to her.

Kojiro wants to get to his girlfriend, so he will go to her along a coordinate line. For simplicity, we can assume that Kojiro is at the point $*f*$ of a coordinate line, and Johanna is at point $*e*$. Some points of the coordinate line have gas stations. Every gas station fills with only one type of fuel: *Regular-92*, *Premium-95* or *Super-98*. Thus, each gas station is characterized by a pair of integers $*t*_{*i*}$ and $*x*_{*i*}$ — the number of the gas type and its position.

One liter of fuel is enough to drive for exactly $1$ km (this value does not depend on the type of fuel). Fuels of three types differ only in quality, according to the research, that affects the lifetime of the vehicle motor. A Furrari tank holds exactly $*s*$ liters of fuel (regardless of the type of fuel). At the moment of departure from point $*f*$ Kojiro's tank is completely filled with fuel *Super-98*. At each gas station Kojiro can fill the tank with any amount of fuel, but of course, at no point in time, the amount of fuel in the tank can be more than $*s*$ liters. Note that the tank **can** simultaneously have different types of fuel. The car can moves both left and right.

To extend the lifetime of the engine Kojiro seeks primarily to minimize the amount of fuel of type *Regular-92*. If there are several strategies to go from $*f*$ to $*e*$, using the minimum amount of fuel of type *Regular-92*, it is necessary to travel so as to minimize the amount of used fuel of type *Premium-95*.

Write a program that can for the $*m*$ possible positions of the start $*f*_{*i*}$ minimize firstly, the amount of used fuel of type *Regular-92* and secondly, the amount of used fuel of type *Premium-95*.

## Input

The first line of the input contains four positive integers $*e*, *s*, *n*, *m*$ ($1 ≤ *e*, *s* ≤ 10^{9}, 1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) — the coordinate of the point where Johanna is, the capacity of a Furrari tank, the number of gas stations and the number of starting points.

Next $*n*$ lines contain two integers each $*t*_{*i*}, *x*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 3,  - 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$), representing the type of the $*i*$-th gas station ($1$ represents *Regular-92*, $2$ — *Premium-95* and $3$ — *Super-98*) and the position on a coordinate line of the $*i*$-th gas station. Gas stations don't necessarily follow in order from left to right.

The last line contains $*m*$ integers $*f*_{*i*}$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *f*_{*i*} < *e*$). Start positions don't necessarily follow in order from left to right.

No point of the coordinate line contains more than one gas station. It is possible that some of points $*f*_{*i*}$ or point $*e*$ coincide with a gas station.

## Output

Print exactly $*m*$ lines. The $*i*$-th of them should contain two integers — the minimum amount of gas of type *Regular-92* and type *Premium-95*, if Kojiro starts at point $*f*_{*i*}$. First you need to minimize the first value. If there are multiple ways to do it, you need to also minimize the second value.

If there is no way to get to Johanna from point $*f*_{*i*}$, the $*i*$-th line should look like that "`-1 -1`" (two numbers minus one without the quotes).
statementZhMd:
驾驶员小次郎花了 $10$ 年时间攒钱，终于买下了自己最喜欢的汽车品牌 Furrari。小次郎的梦想终于实现了！现在，他想去找女朋友 Johanna，向她炫耀自己的爱车。

小次郎想去找女朋友，因此他会沿着一条数轴前往她所在的位置。为简单起见，我们可以假设小次郎位于数轴上的点 $*f*$，而 Johanna 位于点 $*e*$。数轴上的某些点设有加油站。每个加油站只提供一种燃油：*Regular-92*、*Premium-95* 或 *Super-98*。因此，每个加油站都可以用一对整数 $*t*_{*i*}$ 和 $*x*_{*i*}$ 表示，分别代表燃油类型编号和其所在位置。

一升燃油恰好可以行驶 $1$ 千米（该数值与燃油类型无关）。三种燃油的区别仅在于品质；根据研究结果，燃油品质会影响汽车发动机的使用寿命。Furrari 的油箱容量恰好为 $*s*$ 升（与燃油类型无关）。小次郎从点 $*f*$ 出发时，油箱中完全装满了 *Super-98*。在每个加油站，小次郎都可以向油箱中加入任意数量的燃油，但在任何时刻，油箱中的燃油总量都不能超过 $*s*$ 升。注意，油箱中**可以**同时存在不同类型的燃油。汽车既可以向左行驶，也可以向右行驶。

为了延长发动机的使用寿命，小次郎首先希望最小化所使用的 *Regular-92* 燃油量。如果存在多种从 $*f*$ 到 $*e*$ 且使用最少 *Regular-92* 燃油的方案，则还需要在这些方案中最小化所使用的 *Premium-95* 燃油量。

请编写程序，对于 $*m*$ 个可能的起点 $*f*_{*i*}$，首先最小化所使用的 *Regular-92* 燃油量，其次最小化所使用的 *Premium-95* 燃油量。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含四个正整数 $*e*, *s*, *n*, *m*$（$1 ≤ *e*, *s* ≤ 10^{9}, 1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 2·10^{5}$），分别表示 Johanna 所在点的坐标、Furrari 油箱的容量、加油站数量以及起点数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*t*_{*i*}, *x*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 3,  - 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示第 $*i*$ 个加油站的类型及其在数轴上的位置（$1$ 表示 *Regular-92*，$2$ 表示 *Premium-95*，$3$ 表示 *Super-98*）。加油站不一定按照从左到右的顺序给出。

最后一行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*f*_{*i*}$（$- 10^{9} ≤ *f*_{*i*} < *e*$），表示起点的位置。起点不一定按照从左到右的顺序给出。

数轴上的同一点至多有一个加油站。某些点 $*f*_{*i*}$ 或点 $*e*$ 可能与加油站重合。

## 输出格式

恰好输出 $*m*$ 行。第 $*i*$ 行应包含两个整数，分别表示小次郎从点 $*f*_{*i*}$ 出发时所使用的 *Regular-92* 燃油量和 *Premium-95* 燃油量的最小值。首先需要最小化第一个数值；如果有多种方案可以做到这一点，还需要最小化第二个数值。

如果无法从点 $*f*_{*i*}$ 到达 Johanna 所在点，则第 $*i*$ 行应输出 ``-1 -1``（不含引号，即两个负一）。
